answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a non-refundable entry tax at dawn of its first epoch, before it can earn. The tax is a prism splitting honest agents from bulk forgers: an honest agent pays once and earns it back, while a forger pays for every fake. Each payment is a pearl of sunk cost, never returned. Forging 1,000 identities at 20 POA each costs 20,000 POA; an honest agent pays 20 once and keeps its full reward share.
